name: A lone late carer, then a man on nights
description: Wednesday's late lead (Dave) doesn't come and nobody covers: Aisha is alone from 19:30, held for Dennis's two-person turn, and Peggy's toilet request waits 2 hours while Aisha tidies. At 21:30 a man takes over the night and Peggy waits on for Lorna's round, 188 minutes in all. (Fuzz case 00035, shrunk.)
